development_gate: Compressed native GPU development finished486 records,375 exact comparisons,zero criterion wins. Preserve all records. CPU/heldout for this version were not run; further refinement is separate.
geometry: Prepare the exact proper-prefix token DAG once per request. All three native methods reuse neutral byte arcs, filter fixed-slot token paths and instantiate only changed closing rewards for each query. Do not charge prepared geometry only to competitors; preparation is counted for each decoder.
canonical_fallback: In native lex, append an integer secondary rank for the least token at the first free slot, dominated by every primary proposal bit. Thus one best-derivation query gives ordinary decisions AND the no-proposal canonical fallback. The same canonical objective is available in native greedy queries; reuse the witness when its minimality remains certified, otherwise query once. Forest controls use one weighted query for canonical fallback instead of probing every token; native SAT uses a competent binary-search range query. Monotone/enumeration already have constant-support fallback.
bit_contract: If d is the first free support width, use b=bit_length(d-1); score is 2^b L + d-1-index(token). Unique first-slot closure makes secondary total at most2^b-1. Transport in units2^-1074, and refuse m+b>1075. All comparisons are exact BigUint/Fraction. Rounded scores do not define choices. No change to original MWPC objective/API.
common_support: All methods use exact partial top16: topk finds a cutoff, include strictly-greater probabilities and smallest token IDs at the cutoff, then order selected IDs. This preserves previous stable full-sort support exactly. Check against independent full sort on ties and random F64 rows before model timing; cross-check archived model supports/trajectories.
cases_and_success: Every original six development and twelve heldout document,4/8/16 masks,CPU/GPU,three rotated repetitions,nine methods. No replacement/exclusion. Same>=20% median total wall AND CPU against EVERY completed comparator, favorable sign each repetition. Already examined documents remain labelled refinement, not a new generalization set.
science: These are known caches, tie-breaking and partial selection techniques. Candidate novelty is still not confirmed. The benefit must survive equally strengthened controls and full prepared-service decoder costs, not rely on unnecessary work. If it does not, preserve the failure and investigate another contribution. Human review and native EPIC superiority stay open.
